title: Group chat opens do not move ranking
dek: Only actions on posts served in the Home Timeline count toward ranking.
whatChanged: A code comment in xai-value-model says an action only counts for an account when it takes place on a post served in the Home Timeline. Opening a post directly, such as from a group chat link, has no ranking impact. The weights multiply predicted probabilities, so the code does not read raw counts.
meaningForCreators: A link passed around a group chat helps the people in that chat, not the ranking. The work that moves reach is the post itself, as people see it in their feeds.
action: Do this: judge a post by how many people saw it in their feed, not by how many people opened the link.
